verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a business banking platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows in-app workflows, first-party accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero), Plaid connectivity and an llms.txt file. None of these is a documented public API a user or agent could drive programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
